# Agenda fixtures

Trimmed from the live week-42 2026 page and its CasePage responses, captured
2026-10-17. Three original entries preserve department/minister headings, repeated
III:1 numbers, `<br>` title lines and incomplete/multiple journal identifiers.
The weekly fixture deliberately includes the duplicate filtered listing. Result
counts and page boundaries are reduced to exercise pagination with two pages.

Source: https://www.regeringen.se/regeringsarenden/regeringsarenden-vecka-42-2026/
